title: Quantile-Coupled Flow Matching for Distributional Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.08515v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distributional Reinforcement Learning (DRL) models the full return distribution, making it well-suited to uncertainty-aware and risk-sensitive decision-making. Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) critics are increasingly adopted in DRL, offering dense velocity supervision and a natural axis for scaling critic computation. Yet they carry a hidden metric mismatch: the distributional Bellman operator is a contraction in the Wasserstein distance, but CFM critics pair source and Bellman target samples arbitrarily, so their loss does not control the Wasserstein distance to the Bellman target. We show that this mismatch can be fixed with a single sorting operation. Our method, FlowIQN, sorts source and target samples within each mini-batch so that each source quantile is transported to its matching target quantile, approximating the monotone optimal transport coupling. translated_title: 面向分布式强化学习的分位数耦合流匹配
translated_abstract: 分布式强化学习（DRL）对完整的回报分布进行建模，因此非常适合具有不确定性感知和风险敏感性的决策任务。条件流匹配（CFM）评论家在DRL中的采用日益增多，它提供了密集的速度监督以及扩展评论家计算量的自然维度。然而，这类方法存在一个隐藏的度量不匹配问题：分布式贝尔曼算子在Wasserstein距离下是收缩映射，但CFM评论家任意地配对源样本与贝尔曼目标样本，因此其损失并不能控制到贝尔曼目标的Wasserstein距离。我们证明，这种不匹配可以通过一次排序操作来修复。我们的方法FlowIQN在每个小批次内对源样本和目标样本进行排序，使每个源分位数被传输到其对应匹配的目标分位数，从而近似单调最优传输耦合。我们证明，这种分位数耦合使CFM损失成为（原文此处截断）的上界……
tldr: 该论文提出FlowIQN方法，通过在小批次内对源样本和目标样本进行排序形成分位数耦合，修复了条件流匹配评论家与分布式贝尔曼算子之间的Wasserstein度量不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FlowIQN, which sorts source and target samples within each mini-batch to form a quantile coupling, fixing the hidden Wasserstein metric mismatch between Conditional Flow Matching critics and the distributional Bellman operator.
